questions.question: Describe the parts method for sharing R1 800 in the ratio 4 : 5, including the check, and explain the most common mistake.
questions.expected_answer: Total the parts: 4 + 5 = 9. One part: R1 800 ÷ 9 = R200. Multiply out: 4 × R200 = R800 and 5 × R200 = R1 000. Check: R800 + R1 000 = R1 800. The common mistake is dividing by the number of people (2) instead of the number of parts (9).

questions.question: Explain how to increase 240 in the ratio 5 : 3 and how to decrease 240 in the ratio 3 : 5, and give a check on the direction of each answer.
questions.expected_answer: Multiply by new over old: 240 × 5/3 = 400 (increase) and 240 × 3/5 = 144 (decrease). An increase must use a fraction greater than 1 and give a larger result; a decrease must use a fraction less than 1 and give a smaller result. If the direction is wrong, the fraction was inverted.

questions.question: What is the difference between a ratio and a rate? Use the taxi (240 km in 3 h) and the egg prices (6 for R21 versus 18 for R54) to illustrate.
questions.expected_answer: A ratio compares quantities of the same kind and has no units (e.g. 4 : 5). A rate compares different kinds and keeps its units: 240 km ÷ 3 h = 80 km/h. To compare rates, reduce to a unit rate: R21 ÷ 6 = R3,50 per egg versus R54 ÷ 18 = R3 per egg, so the 18-egg box is the better buy.
